crossRefs.note: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.
All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”
All Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall not do any more wickedness like this among you.
All the men of his city shall stone him to death with stones. So you shall remove the evil from among you. All Israel…
But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.
Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.
Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.
Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.
A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel:
Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.
The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

translations.web: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.
translations.bsb: When a mocker is punished, the simple gain wisdom; and when a wise man is instructed, he acquires knowledge.
translations.kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
translations.asv: When the scoffer is punished, the simple is made wise; And when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
